scope: Key-gated (API-key) providers among the legacy 30-provider catalog, researched from current official documentation. GitHub Models was excluded from the findings because official docs report the service was retired on 2026-07-30.

findings.evidence_summary: Official Groq docs confirm the OpenAI-compatible base URL https://api.groq.com/openai/v1 and still list llama-3.1-8b-instant among current models (30 RPM, 14.4K RPD, 6K TPM, 500K TPD). Auth is a Bearer API key.
findings.notes: Current rate-limits page documents only Developer-plan base limits and does not explicitly mention a free tier; third-party sources widely claim free access, hence 'claimed'.

findings.evidence_summary: Official Gemini API rate-limit docs explicitly define a 'Free' usage tier (per-project rate limits, no credit card) and still list Gemini 2.5 Flash as an active text-generation model.
findings.notes: Auth via x-goog-api-key header or key query param. Newer flash models (Gemini 3.5/3.6 Flash) now exist, but gemini-2.5-flash remains listed/active. Free-tier data may be used by Google to improve products.

findings.evidence_summary: Mistral's official API reference documents the /v1/chat/completions endpoint and the model alias 'mistral-small-latest', which routes to the latest Mistral Small (currently Mistral Small 4, ID mistral-small-2603). Official docs also reference activating Studio in Free mode to generate an API key.
findings.notes: Free 'Experiment'/'Free mode' tier is documented; requires opting into data training and has rate limits (~1 req/s, 500K TPM per third-party sources). Some sources report free-tier keys expire after 30 days (unverified).

findings.evidence_summary: Official build.nvidia.com model page confirms model ID nvidia/nemotron-3-nano-30b-a3b with a free endpoint, base URL https://integrate.api.nvidia.com/v1, API-key auth (env NVIDIA_API_KEY), and states all models on build.nvidia.com are free to prototype with, rate-limited (up to 40 RPM).
findings.notes: Free tier is for prototyping only (rate-limited, no per-token billing). Keys are account-scoped with an nvapi- prefix. The '1000 free credits' figure from third parties was not present on the official page.

findings.evidence_summary: Cohere's API reference documents the v2 base URL https://api.cohere.com/v2 (POST /v2/chat) and lists command-r7b-12-2024 as a current Command model. The pricing page explicitly states API calls made from a Trial API key are free, though rate-limited and not permitted for production.
findings.notes: Cohere's newer docs pages also show https://api.cohere.ai/v2; the SDK accepts both domains. Official examples use a CO_API_KEY env var, but auth is a standard bearer API key.

findings.evidence_summary: OpenRouter docs confirm the OpenAI-compatible base URL https://openrouter.ai/api/v1 with endpoints like /api/v1/chat/completions, Bearer API-key auth, and free models denoted by a :free suffix (e.g., openai/gpt-oss-20b:free) with rate limits.
findings.notes: openrouter.ai is behind Cloudflare and blocks direct fetches; content verified via a recent Wayback Machine snapshot of the official docs. Free-model availability changes frequently, so the :free model list should be re-verified.

findings.evidence_summary: SambaNova docs confirm the OpenAI-compatible base URL https://api.sambanova.ai/v1 (base host + /v1/models) and list Meta-Llama-3.3-70B-Instruct as a production model. Official rate-limits docs define a Free Tier for accounts with no payment method, and the plans page offers $5 in initial credits.
findings.notes: Free-tier rate limits (RPM/RPD/TPD) apply when no payment method is linked; the initial $5 credit expiry is stated inconsistently (30 days vs 3 months) across official pages.

findings.evidence_summary: Official quickstart confirms the OpenAI-compatible base URL https://api.siliconflow.cn/v1 with API-key auth. Docs home states small models such as Qwen2.5 (7B) are available free, and the official model page lists the exact model ID Qwen/Qwen3-8B.
findings.notes: The international platform prices Qwen/Qwen3-8B at $0.06/M tokens, while the .cn platform officially advertises free access to small models; current free-model lists should be confirmed in the console.

findings.evidence_summary: Official DeepSeek API docs list OpenAI-compatible base URL https://api.deepseek.com and current text models deepseek-v4-flash and deepseek-v4-pro; the legacy name deepseek-chat is deprecated. Auth is a DeepSeek API key sent as Authorization: Bearer, shown in docs as DEEPSEEK_API_KEY. The official pricing page lists no free tier or free credits.
findings.notes: Fallback model deepseek-chat is no longer listed as current (deprecated); /v1 is a documented OpenAI-compatible alias of the same base URL. No official free tier found.

findings.evidence_summary: Official Z.AI pricing page lists GLM-4.7-Flash and GLM-4.5-Flash as free ($0). The chat-completions API reference confirms model ID glm-4.7-flash, Bearer-token auth, and OpenAI-compatible base URL https://api.z.ai/api/paas/v4.
findings.notes: Fallback model glm-4-flash is no longer listed on official docs; the current free flash text model is glm-4.7-flash. China-platform alternative endpoint is https://open.bigmodel.cn/api/paas/v4, where dated alias glm-4-flash-250414 is still free.

findings.evidence_summary: Official Cerebras inference docs confirm OpenAI-compatible base URL https://api.cerebras.ai/v1, production model gpt-oss-120b, and auth via CEREBRAS_API_KEY (Authorization: Bearer). The rate-limits page states new accounts receive $5 in free credits after adding a verified payment method, expiring 30 days after they are granted.
findings.notes: Free access is a limited free-trial credit ($5, 30-day expiry) plus a free-trial tier with reduced context window and rate limits, not permanently free access.

findings.evidence_summary: Official Inference Providers docs show an OpenAI-compatible chat completions endpoint at https://router.huggingface.co/v1/chat/completions, authenticated with a Bearer HF token (HF_TOKEN). Docs state 'Inference Providers includes a generous free tier' with additional credits for PRO users. meta-llama/Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct is still actively served.

REST API docs confirm the run endpoint https://api.cloudflare.com/client/v4/accounts/{ACCOUNT_ID}/ai/run/{model} with Account ID in the URL path and Authorization: Bearer API token (CLOUDFLARE_API_TOKEN); @cf/meta/llama-3.1-8b-instruct is the documented example model. Pricing docs confirm 10,000 free Neurons per day.
findings.notes: Free tier of 10,000 Neurons/day applies to both Free and Paid Workers plans; see https://developers.cloudflare.com/workers-ai/platform/pricing/.

findings.evidence_summary: Official cloud docs show ollama.com acts as a remote Ollama host using native endpoints /api/tags and /api/chat; an API key created at ollama.com/settings/keys is set as OLLAMA_API_KEY and sent as a Bearer header. Docs do not document a free tier or any OpenAI-compatible /v1 endpoint.
findings.notes: Fallback base_url https://api.ollama.com is not used in official docs; the host is https://ollama.com. Fallback model llama3.1:8b was not confirmed as an available cloud model; gpt-oss:120b is the documented Cloud API example. A free tier is claimed by third-party sources only, not by official docs.
